g.text: 24.4 Hallucination complaints: verify, narrow, then fix
the first step is the rate; the signature of the cause picks the fix
4 reproduce: replay old vs new config
5 fix: mitigate first, root cause next
vendor model update: spike across intents
prompt regression: spike after a prompt edit
stale knowledge base: one policy intent
retrieval miss: right answer not retrieved
new intent with no content behind it
cost-driven change: smaller model, less text
mitigate in 24-48 hours: roll back or gate the intent
